note: Forbidden: OSPF packets sent with a TTL other than 1. Red: TestOSPFSocketTTLIsOne first proves the kernel default is not 1, then fails unless IP_TTL and IP_MULTICAST_TTL both read back 1 after setMulticastOptions (which hard-codes 1, backend_linux.go:307-316). Other polarity: TestOSPFSocketTTLFailureIsAnError fails if a setsockopt failure is swallowed, so a socket cannot enter service with the default TTL.
